# Katherine Kleyman, Esq.

> Plaintiff-side employment attorney representing employees in New York and California in wrongful termination, retaliation, discrimination, and workplace harassment matters.

Katherine Kleyman is a former corporate counsel and Fordham University School of Law graduate. She represents workers, not employers. Free case reviews are available for potential employment claims, and paid strategy sessions are available for employees seeking focused guidance while still employed. Contingency-based representation is available in qualified cases.

Contact: 1-646-583-5001 · 221 Kings Hwy, Brooklyn, NY 11223
Canonical website: https://www.kleymanesq.com

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.kleymanesq.com/): Attorney overview, practice areas, New York and California coverage, and consultation options.
- [About Katherine](https://www.kleymanesq.com/about): Former corporate counsel experience, Fordham Law education, NY and CA admissions, and employee-only representation.
- [Practice Areas](https://www.kleymanesq.com/practice-areas): Overview of employee-side employment law services.
- [Wrongful Termination](https://www.kleymanesq.com/practice-areas/wrongful-termination): Review of potentially unlawful termination matters.
- [Workplace Retaliation](https://www.kleymanesq.com/practice-areas/retaliation): Adverse action after protected workplace activity.
- [Workplace Discrimination](https://www.kleymanesq.com/practice-areas/discrimination): Unlawful treatment based on protected characteristics.
- [Workplace Harassment](https://www.kleymanesq.com/practice-areas/workplace-harassment): Hostile, abusive, or sexually harassing workplace conduct.
- [New York Employment Law](https://www.kleymanesq.com/new-york): Representation in New York City, Long Island, Westchester, and statewide.
- [California Employment Law](https://www.kleymanesq.com/california): Representation in Los Angeles, San Francisco, San Diego, San Jose, Orange County, Sacramento, Oakland, and statewide.
- [Employment Law FAQ](https://www.kleymanesq.com/faq): General answers about claims, fees, deadlines, and consultations.
- [Contact](https://www.kleymanesq.com/contact): Free case review, paid strategy session, telephone, and Brooklyn office details.
